run_EndToEndSemanticScout: run the EndToEndSemanticScout agent to navigate a robot toward a specified object goal using semantic segmentation
run_RLSegFTAgent_act: run the RLSegFTAgent act method to get navigation actions from RGB depth and GPS observations
create_EndToEndSemanticScout: create an EndToEndSemanticScout instance with a mover, object goal, episode ID, and policy config
review_RLSegFTAgent: review the RLSegFTAgent class that loads a policy model and runs inference with semantic segmentation
summarize_EndToEndSemanticScout_step: summarize the EndToEndSemanticScout step method that processes observations and executes low-level robot navigation commands
